svg.title: Akshay Bajpai. In thrust we trust. I lead technology from the first client conversation to the release: the architecture, the team, the code, and the runbook after. Boardroom to bare metal. A rocket engine is drawn by a plotter and lit; an x-ray lens drifts over it and shows the software inside.

conversation to the release: the architecture,
